description: Only the uv version pinned in the setup-uv steps of .github/workflows/ci.yml. Dependabot already covers the `uses:` SHA pins and pyproject/uv.lock, but has no manager for the `version:` input of astral-sh/setup-uv, so that pin would otherwise never move. Every other manager stays off so the two bots never compete for the same dependency; this repo has no Kubernetes manifests or Dockerfile.
